pubchem_continuous_policy: -Fit_LogAC50; finite fitted values including inconclusive retained with hitcall/QC; raw Max_Response separately retained
chembl_policy: Human or unspecified assay organism, human single-protein target confidence >=8 A/B/F; quality flags excluded; all PubChem imports excluded; explicit TDI excluded, preincubation flagged but retained
identity_policy: Reuse ChEMBL-parent pipeline mappings, standardize newly admitted structures; exclude all challenge connectivity, overlaps retained separately
replicate_policy: One row per original source observation; no cross-assay aggregation
